'''Biswarup Mukhopadhyaya''' (born 1 August 1960) is an Indian theoretical [[High energy physics|high energy physicist]] and a senior professor at [[Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Kolkata]] (IISER Kolkata).<ref name="Designation: Professor I">{{Cite web |url=http://www.hri.res.in/people/Physics/biswarup |title=Designation: Professor I |date=2017-10-22 |website=Harish-Chandra Research Institute |access-date=2017-10-22 |archive-date=22 October 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171022142745/http://www.hri.res.in/people/Physics/biswarup |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Discovery of Higgs Boson: Reality and Myth">{{Cite web |url=http://iiti.ac.in/Seminars/Abstract/11042013.html |title=Discovery of Higgs Boson: Reality and Myth |date=2017-10-22 |website=IIT Indore |access-date=2017-10-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171022142704/http://iiti.ac.in/Seminars/Abstract/11042013.html |archive-date=22 October 2017 }}</ref> Known for his research on High energy [[collider]]s, [[Higgs boson]]s, [[neutrino]]s,<ref name="Biswarup Mukhopadhyaya on HBNI">{{Cite web |url=http://www.hbni.ac.in/faculty/HRI/hrial_phys_mukhopadhyaya_biswarup.htm |title=Biswarup Mukhopadhyaya on HBNI |date=2017-10-22 |website=Homi Bhabha National Institute |access-date=2017-10-22 |archive-date=16 November 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201116101018/http://www.hbni.ac.in/faculty/HRI/hrial_phys_mukhopadhyaya_biswarup.htm }}</ref> Mukhopadhyaya is an elected fellow of the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]].<ref name="NASI fellows">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nasi.org.in/fellows.asp?RsFilter=M |title=NASI fellows |date=2017 |publisher=National Academy of Sciences, India}}</ref> The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to physical sciences in 2003.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx |title=View Bhatnagar Awardees |date=2017-11-11 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=2017-11-11}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Long link - please select award year to see details}}

== Biography ==
Mukhopadhyaya, who secured his PhD from the [[Rajabazar Science College|Rajabazar Science College campus of Calcutta University]], has done reportedly notable work on [[neutrino mass]]<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/Detail.aspx?AID=199 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2017-10-21 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=2017-10-21}}</ref> and is known to have been successful in theorizing that gauge boson fusion as the ''dominant mode of  supersymmetric particle production''.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research |access-date=2017-10-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |archive-date=4 March 2016 }}</ref> He has delivered invited lectures at a number of conferences<ref name="International Conference on particles, Strings and Cosmology">{{Cite web |url=http://www.hri.res.in/~anlweb/academic_reports_physics/p_mukho_b/p_mukho_b.html |title=International Conference on particles, Strings and Cosmology |date=2017-10-22 |website=Harish-Chandra Research Institute |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> and was a member of the national organizing committees of the International Conference on particles, Strings and Cosmology (PASCOS), held in Mumbai in 2003<ref name="Neutrino-Antineutrino Asymmetry around Rotating Black Hole">{{Cite web |url=http://theory.tifr.res.in/pascos/Proceedings/ |title=Neutrino-Antineutrino Asymmetry around Rotating Black Hole |date=2017-10-22 |website=Tata Institute of Fundamental Research |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> as well as the XXI DAE-BRNS High Energy Physics Symposium held in 2014.<ref name="XXI DAE-BRNS High Energy Physics Symposium 2014">{{Cite web |url=http://www.iitg.ernet.in/DAE-HEP2014/public/committee.php |title=XXI DAE-BRNS High Energy Physics Symposium 2014 |date=2017-10-22 |website=IIT Guwahati |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> His studies have been documented by way of a number of articles{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and [[ResearchGate]], an online article repository of scientific articles, has listed 184 of them.<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/9169872_Biswarup_Mukhopadhyaya |title=On ResearchGate |date=2017-10-17 |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref> He has also edited one book, ''Physics at the Large Hadron Collider'', along with [[Amitava Datta]] and [[Amitava Raychaudhuri]]<ref name="DattaMukhopadhyaya2010">{{cite book|author1=Amitava Datta|author2=B. Mukhopadhyaya|author3=A. Raychaudhuri|title=Physics at the Large Hadron Collider|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=IbwYk8YpHA8C|date=30 May 2010|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-81-8489-295-6}}</ref> and has contributed chapters to books edited by others.<ref name="LassilaQiu1996">{{cite book|author1=K E Lassila|author2=J Qiu|author3=A Sommerer|author4=G Valencia|author5=K Whisnant|author6=B-L Young|title=Particle Theory and Phenomenology: Proceedings of XVII International Kazimierz Meeting on Particle Physics and of the Madison Phenomenology Symposium|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=ovAnDwAAQBAJ&pg=PA255|date=30 November 1996|publisher=World Scientific|isbn=978-981-4547-00-0|pages=255–}}</ref>
